old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-hs1h","title":"Revoke outstanding sender-control authorities at SCHC terminal transition","description":"Security review of the manager-issued raw SCHC egress fix found that _finish_unlocked drops outstanding data-fragment authorities but not previously issued sender ACK-REQ/control authorities.
